messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: path diagram for blavaan
parts:
There is no built-in support for path diagrams in blavaan. But blavaan objects are built on lavaan objects, so any functionality for lavaan models might also apply to blavaan models. For example, I believe the semPlot package will work with lavaan models. If you had a blavaan object called "fit", then I would try this command:

class(fit) <- "lavaan"

and then send it to the semPlot package as a lavaan model. I have not tested it, though.

Ed

messages.subject: Re: path diagram for blavaan
parts: There is a promising package called lavaanPlot (using the beautiful DiagrammeR graphs) that should be able to do perfect plots in the future, right now it only handles manifest variables. So... in this moment I think that semPlot should be the best option available. You also have this possibility (https://rpubs.com/tjmahr/sem_diagrammer), it' a kind of manual solution to transport the models to DiagrammeR, although I should say that you will need to adapt the code or use the exact same package versions reported.
